items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: And one of the help got Johnny McGovern, who was a tough Irish kid. And we're standing there listening to this guy talk... And McGovern says, don't kill him, shake him.

ctx.x: 1946 or '45 . We were in high school together in , and we made a pilgrimage to Chicago to McGovern's Liberty Inn. Had the sign along that wall, and I still have the pictures we took of each other in McGovern's Liberty Inn. Reading about it in the

Some of the things I've read that were written about the happenings, they were very strange happenings. McGovern -- the old man was from the old school. He was a big Irish -- slim, pretty slim, a little bit of a paunch but not much. And I imagine at that time he was over 70, but still very spry and active.
And he liked to have women around, so the was always full of women that had nowhere to go in life,
